summary:
*You See Colours* is the second studio album by British rock band Delays, released by Rough Trade Records on 6 March 2006. Recorded at studios in England and Wales with producer Graham Sutton, it marked a shift from the guitar-focused sound of their debut toward indie rock and pop, with catchy melodies that foreground singer Greg Gilbert’s vocals.

The album followed a period of extensive songwriting, during which the band’s keyboardist lost their demo recordings and other members began contributing to the writing. Critics generally responded favourably, praising the production and musicianship. It earned a Metacritic score of 73 out of 100 and reached number 24 on the UK Albums Chart. Its singles “Valentine” and “Hideaway” peaked at numbers 23 and 35 on the UK Singles Chart, respectively.
